what_to_detect: A damage event meets a redirection replacement and its outgoing event names a different recipient than the incoming one (Forge writes result updated where part of the damage stays, replaced where all of it moves).
near_miss: A damage event meets a damage replacement whose outgoing event keeps the incoming recipient (an amount change only).

what_to_detect: A rewrite whose incoming event is a phase or step beginning (replacement mode BeginPhase; a turn beginning is BeginTurn) and whose result is replaced (a one-shot 'skip your next' effect, whose overriding ability exiles the effect) or skipped (a Skip$ True effect skipping every occurrence): the phase, step or turn does not happen.
near_miss: A BeginPhase or BeginTurn rewrite whose result is not_replaced, so the phase, step or turn begins.
record_fields: rewrite.payload.incoming.type = state_flag_change (BeginPhase has no EVENT_BY_MODE entry)

what_to_detect: A permanent entering the battlefield meets an enters-modifying replacement effect whose substituted ability makes other objects change zones (the resolution holds zone_change events for objects other than the one entering).
near_miss: A permanent enters with an enters-modifying replacement that moves no other object.
record_fields: resolution payload zone_change events with subjects other than the entering object

what_to_detect: A decision candidate is not castable because its cost includes an event a static ability says can't happen (paying life under a can't-change-life static): a failed_checks entry with check cost that names a responsible static.
near_miss: A candidate whose cost includes such a payment and passes the cost check, no static forbidding it.
